releases.name: v1.1.0
releases.body:
A **Refresh** action for a `ValsSecret`, and the resources of [vals-operator](https://github.com/digitalis-io/vals-operator) v0.14.0.

### What is new

- **Refresh a `ValsSecret`** from the toolbar of its details or from the menu of its row in the list. vals-operator reads the backend again on the next reconcile, without waiting for the TTL and without a change of the spec; the `Secret`, or the custom target, is rewritten, and its rollouts run, only when the data changed.
  - The action sets the annotation `vals-operator.digitalis.io/refresh-requested-at` to the current time. It is disabled until the operator has handled the request, so that one click is one read of the backend, and a failed read is retried by the operator.
  - It needs vals-operator v0.14.0 or newer together with the `ValsSecret` CRD of that release. With an older operator or an older CRD the request stays pending.
  - `DbSecret`s have no such action.
- **Refresh in the details**: the details of a `ValsSecret` show the generation last applied to its `Secret`, the requested refresh, marked "Pending" until the operator handles it, and the last handled one.
- **vals-operator v0.14.0**: the status of a `ValsSecret` gains `secretGeneration` and `lastHandledRefreshAt`. The `DbSecret` API is unchanged, and objects of an older operator show as before.

### Release

- Tested with Freelens 2.0.0 and 2.1.0.
- The release now has a CycloneDX SBOM next to the SPDX one, and a build provenance attestation for its assets:

  ```sh
  gh attestation verify freelensapp-vals-extension-1.1.0.tgz --repo freelensapp/freelens-vals-extension
  ```

### Install

From the Freelens Extensions page, by npm name:

```text
@freelensapp/vals-extension
```

Requires Freelens 2.0.0 or newer, and vals-operator v0.12.0 or newer; the Refresh action needs v0.14.0. See the [README](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-vals-extension#readme).

**Full changelog**: [v1.0.0...v1.1.0](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-vals-extension/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0)

releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
The first release of the Freelens extension for [vals-operator](https://github.com/digitalis-io/vals-operator): the `ValsSecret`s and `DbSecret`s that sync secrets from Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager and the other backends of [vals](https://github.com/helmfile/vals) into Kubernetes `Secret`s, inside Freelens.

### What is in it

- **Vals** in the cluster sidebar, with a list page for each kind of vals-operator v0.12.0. The `ValsSecret`s and `DbSecret`s are no longer listed a second time under Custom Resources.
- **Vals Secrets**: each `ValsSecret` with the `Secret` it writes and the number of its data keys. Its details show:
  - the annotations of the written `Secret` (with the time of its last update) or of the object of a custom target,
  - the `ref` of every data source,
  - the templates, in a read-only editor,
  - the databases whose password the operator updates,
  - the rollout targets,
  - the custom target, with its template and its last apply.
- **DB Secrets**: each `DbSecret` with its `Secret`, the Vault mount and role that issue its credentials, and whether the operator renews their lease. Its details show the annotations of the `Secret`, with the lease and its expiry, the templates and the rollout targets.
- **Read only, and no secret values**: the written `Secret`, the database login and the rollout targets link to their own details in Freelens. The extension never reads the data of a `Secret`: it shows the reference of a secret, never its value, and reads only the metadata of the objects that the operator writes.

### Install

From the Freelens Extensions page, by npm name:

```text
@freelensapp/vals-extension
```

Requires Freelens 2.0.0 or newer and vals-operator v0.12.0. See the [README](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-vals-extension#readme).
